blocks.heading: Your Right to Privacy
blocks.body:
Your right to privacy is respected by **Jungle Safari India**. Your name, date of birth, address, phone number, and personal identification information shared with us is kept strictly confidential.

All identity documentation provided for government park gate verification is protected under strict access controls.

blocks.heading: Use of Personal Information
blocks.body: **Jungle Safari India** guarantees that personal information is only used or disclosed to the extent necessary to process safari permits and fulfill your booked services.

blocks.heading: Sharing with Subsidiaries & Business Partners
blocks.body: If personal information is shared with local resorts, taxi drivers, or naturalist trackers, it is done solely to facilitate your scheduled reservation in Sawai Madhopur.

blocks.heading: Site Analytics & Experience Improvement
blocks.body: To enhance visitor experience, aggregate web traffic trends may be analyzed anonymously to optimize page performance, fast form loading, and booking workflows.

blocks.heading: Security Protections & Web Disclaimer
blocks.body: We utilize standard SSL encryption and secure communication channels to protect the confidentiality of personal booking records.

blocks.heading: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
blocks.body: Cookies improve website performance by remembering form preferences and session variables. Cookies never access data from your hard drive or external websites.

blocks.heading: Policy Modifications & User Consent
blocks.body: Ranthambore Wild Life Tour reserves the right to periodically update this privacy statement to reflect new statutory data guidelines. Use of this site implies agreement to these conditions.

blocks.heading: Contact & Privacy Queries
blocks.body:
Contact **Jungle Safari India** at our booking email if you have questions regarding data privacy.

Contact Jungle Safari India if you have inquiries or concerns about privacy matters.
